finalists.label: Anorectal cancer

finalists.label: Anorectal Fistula
finalists.why: This candidate has a strong history of perianal fistula and multiple external fistula openings, but lacks decisive evidence of a malignant process.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of mucinous adenocarcinoma in the biopsy specimen and the specific location of the mass at the level of the anorectal junction made Anorectal mucinous adenocarcinoma the most compelling diagnosis.
